news.title: Extreme heat expected again at the Grand Canyon after 3 hikers die in heat-related incidents
news.summary: The U.S. National Weather Service issued an extreme heat watch at the Grand Canyon for midday Monday through Tuesday, forecasting temperatures that could reach or exceed 110 degrees Fahrenheit at the low-elevation Phantom Ranch.
